addon_policy.retired_note: C2 is retained as historical audit evidence only. It is not an active candidate, is excluded from the comparison and decision surface, and its o_min is not tuned further. It was retired because the implemented 'three consecutive claims' is a claim-PERSISTENCE measure, not the approved historical touch-occupancy O, and it reversed the role of the secondary evidence from hold to release. The dwell count must never be described as occupancy.
addon_policy.c1_horizon_adequacy_note: Only 1 of 23 entitled synthetic fixtures reach the 120-bar post-eligible decision horizon at all, and none of those establishes a definite withholding. The rest are administratively right-censored. The synthetic set therefore CANNOT estimate the permanent-withholding rate or C1's opportunity cost: that measurement requires the real B3 cohort, whose events are followed for the full horizon. Quoting a synthetic percentage as a withholding probability would be unsupported.
addon_policy.c1_denominator_note: c1_withheld_share_of_evaluable = numerator / denominator, where the numerator is the count of POLICY_WITHHELD_THROUGH_EXPIRY episodes and the denominator is the count of parent-eligible episodes whose predeclared decision horizon was fully observed. Episodes that were released, or that the baseline de-risked, count in the denominator with a zero numerator; right-censored episodes are excluded from BOTH because their future is unknown. Including them in the numerator is what produced the earlier uninterpretable 14/23 = 60.9% figure. That figure is WITHDRAWN and must not be quoted as a withholding probability, a market estimate or a basis for any cutoff.

c1_superseded_figure.reason: summed right-censored episodes (including fixtures that end before the eligible decision bar) into a permanent-withholding count

addon_policy.c1_delay_scope: max/mean are over episodes whose add-on was actually RELEASED. Unobserved delays are excluded from both and are never reported as 0 additional bars.
addon_policy.c1_signal_gate_invariant_note: INVARIANT, NOT EVIDENCE. Because reference_is_valid is a superset of the frozen claim gate's non-novelty conjuncts, a claim implies a valid reference, so a policy that withholds only on an invalid reference can never withhold a claiming bar. A zero count here is a tautology of the gate and must NOT be reported as empirical protection or as evidence that C1 is safe.
addon_policy.genuine_trend_note: Definitely-withheld fixtures whose path left the envelope and never returned (parameter-free test), EXCLUDING fixtures that are deliberately broken or built only to instrument a guard. 'Sustained escape' is an OUTCOME label (it reads the future path), never an ex-ante stratum input, and it is not a claim that the trend was worth adding to: one_tick_breakout clears the frozen high by 0.02, where withholding is arguably correct.
addon_policy.c1_censored_note: Conservative hold is an explicit POLICY CHOICE with all opportunity cost charged, and it is reported with its full cost. Whether the resulting opportunity cost is acceptable is a joint loss-protection / MFE>=8 ATR harvest-retention decision reserved for Sophira; it is NOT derived from these synthetic fixtures.

wide_box_stratum.feature_definition: (Q90 - Q10) of the pre-probe reference closes divided by the mean true range over the last ATR_WINDOW_BARS pre-probe bars
wide_box_stratum.edge_provenance: feature-only tertiles of the REAL Issue #76 B3 cohort, computed by analyze_issue185_real_cohort.py with no return, PnL or MFE input
wide_box_stratum.bin_rule: NARROW: width_atr < edge0; WIDE: width_atr >= edge1; MID: between. Reversal bins are the predeclared integer bins 0 / 1 / 2+.
wide_box_stratum.zero_data_rule: UNAVAILABLE (never silently binned) when fewer than ATR_WINDOW_BARS+1 pre-probe bars exist, when the window spans a coordinate reset so its closes share no price coordinate, when the pre-probe ATR is not strictly positive, or when the reference span is not strictly positive.
wide_box_stratum.causality: range_regime_at slices bars[anchor - reference_bars:anchor] and never reads bars[anchor] or later; appending future bars cannot change the result, and the test suite asserts that.
wide_box_stratum.sustained_escape_note: sustained_escape() scans every bar after the probe and asks whether price ever returned to the old envelope. It is retained ONLY as an outcome label and is never an input to the stratum.

superseded_criteria.spread_over_w: IDENTITY, not a classifier: spread/w == RADIUS_DIVISOR for every valid reference
superseded_criteria.R_le_1_plus_claim: selects sparse CLAIMED TERRITORY, not a wide trading range

wide_box_stratum.discrimination_note: A tautological criterion would produce exactly 1 distinct value across all episodes. The reported distinct-value count is the falsification test for that failure mode.
wide_box_stratum.synthetic_discrimination_caveat: Most synthetic fixtures are built from the same boxed reference construction, so their pre-probe widths cluster and the descriptor has limited spread on them by construction. The synthetic distinct-value count is therefore a SANITY CHECK (it is > 1, so the feature is not constant), not a claim about discriminating power. The stratum's discriminating power rests on the real cohort, where the feature takes 661 distinct values across 661 usable B3 events.

real_cohort.note: Computed from the operator-side Issue #76 export, which is NOT committed to this repository (private market data). The raw files are identified by SHA-256 in the committed manifest; the numbers are NOT reproducible in CI and are never presented as if they were.

addon_policy.c1_declared_dispositions_never_observed_: A declared disposition with no observation is disclosed rather than left implicit. BASELINE_HANDLES is additionally PROVABLY unreachable in the trusted-R<=1 no-claim state -- see abstain_branch, and note the scope correction recorded there: this does not make conservative hold a mathematical necessity. BASELINE_DE_RISK_BEFORE_RELEASE and ALREADY_FULL are unreachable on the synthetic set only because no fixture declares a deterioration or a pre-existing full position, and both are exercised by the unit tests.

abstain_branch.conclusion: the abstain outcome is provably unreachable: a trusted reference at R<=1 always claims, because reference_is_valid() is a superset of the frozen claim gate's non-novelty conjuncts
abstain_branch.prereg_consequence: This is a fact about ONE state (a TRUSTED reference at R<=1 that makes no claim), not about the degraded state. It does NOT mean the 'abstain vs conservative hold' decision is mathematically unavailable: a policy could route DEGRADED/UNKNOWN straight to the unmodified baseline -- see BASELINE_ON_DEGRADED_ALTERNATIVE -- and that needs no change to the frozen instrument.
abstain_branch.scope_correction: An earlier revision of this report claimed the abstain-vs-hold choice 'cannot be exercised as a policy parameter' and cited this scan as proof. That inference was WRONG and is withdrawn: this scan concerns the trusted-R<=1 no-claim state only. C1 chooses conservative hold for DEGRADED/UNKNOWN as an explicit POLICY PREFERENCE about which error to prefer (Sophira approved), with all opportunity cost charged, and NOT because mathematics forces it.

parent_event_provenance.export_note: The Issue #76 Pine forward-logger export is PRIVATE market data and is NOT committed to this repository. The parity rehearsal below was run locally against an operator-supplied copy and is recorded as a contract with provenance, not as a CI-checkable step. The exact input files are identified in the committed real-cohort manifest by name, size and SHA-256.
parent_event_provenance.parity_assertions_source: analyze_issue78_second_entry_economic_policy.py lines 741-757 (event count, episode count, B3 event count, P1/P2 count)
parent_event_provenance.rehearsal_note: Counts-only rehearsal of the frozen assertions against a real export. No return, PnL or forward performance quantity was computed: the rehearsal stops before build_state_map and all economics, and scipy's rankdata (used only by the parent's conditional/outcome helpers) was stubbed to raise.
parent_event_provenance.addon_eligibility_rule: P0/P1/P2 add at B3_break_t + CONFIRMATION_BARS; P3 never adds; an episode without a usable B3 stays at Probe

phase2_outcomes.max_added_delay_vs_v02_bars_scope: max over fixtures that still claim under BOTH configurations; for a suppressed fixture the added delay is unbounded (NaN in the CSV), not zero
